newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg completes Lender's Bagels purchase.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg completes Lender's Bagels purchase.

text.p: Kellogg Co said Monday it completed its acquisition of the Lender's Bagels business from Kraft Foods Inc, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc.
In November, Kellogg said it agreed to acquire Lender's Bagels for $455 million.
The purchase includes Lender's plants in Connecticut, Illinois and New York State, Kellogg said in statement.
Lender's is the leading U.S. manufacturer and marketer of frozen, refrigerated and fresh bagels, Kellogg said.
"We're excited about adding the strong Lender's Bagels brand to our fast-growing convenience foods business," said Arnold Langbo, Kellogg's chairman, said in a statement.
Kellogg's stock was up 1/4 Monday afternoon at 65-5/8.
